preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM legacy_users l LEFT JOIN users u ON u.legacy_id=l.id WHERE u.id IS NULL

SELECT count(*) FROM legacy_refresh_token l JOIN users u ON u.legacy_id=l.user_id LEFT JOIN auth_tokens a ON a.token_hash=l.token_hash AND a.user_id=u.id AND a.type='REFRESH' AND a.family_id=l.family_id WHERE l.expires_at>(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AND l.revoked_at IS NULL AND a.id IS NULL
